name: aiecp
description: AI Engineering Control Plane — root orchestrator. Ties discovery/cli, executor, and adapters/agents into one install/build/test flow. See STATUS.md for current phase.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=discovery/cli && npm run build --workspace=executor && npm run build --workspace=adapters/agents
scripts.test: npm test --workspace=discovery/cli && npm test --workspace=executor && npm test --workspace=adapters/agents
scripts.bootstrap: npm run install:all && npm run build && npm run test
